name: ticket
title: Ticket
description: A ticket with concave corners, a bite out of both edges where the stub tears off, and a row of holes along the tear. The holes are cut out of the paper, so the desk (and the shadow) show through. A body, a stub, spaced capitals in the typewriter font and a serial number in red.

a11y: A ticket is a `div`. Give it `role="group"` and a label when several sit on a page. The stub is an `aside` with `role="note"`, so a page of tickets does not fill up with unnamed complementary landmarks.

The drawn paper, notches, holes and frames are aria-hidden decoration; the ticket's information is text in the body and stub. Punched is shown by a hole and a data attribute: also say it in text ("Used") if it matters.

Ink on every ticket stock is at least 9:1; the serial number is a red darkened with ink and reads at least 4.9:1 on kraft, yellow and pink. The tilt is zero in calm density; Windows high contrast replaces the drawing with an outline.
meta.usage:
import { Ticket, TicketBody, TicketDescription, TicketNumber, TicketStub, TicketTitle } from "@/components/ui/ticket"

<Ticket role="group" aria-label="Ticket 0042">
  <TicketBody>
    <TicketTitle>Admit one</TicketTitle>
    <TicketDescription>Le Grand Jardin</TicketDescription>
  </TicketBody>
  <TicketStub><TicketNumber>No. 0042</TicketNumber></TicketStub>
</Ticket>
